scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build:baseline && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:tc001: npm run build:shared && npm run build:baseline && TC001_INTEGRATION=1 node --test tests/integration/tc001-integration.test.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run validate:openapi && npm run verify:fixture && npm run typecheck:shared
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:baseline && npm test
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run db:up && npm run db:load
